message: cannot borrow data in dereference of `std::sync::RwLockReadGuard<'_, HashMap<String, i64>>` as mutable

code.explanation:
This error occurs because you tried to mutably borrow a non-mutable variable.

Erroneous code example:

```compile_fail,E0596
let x = 1;
let y = &mut x; // error: cannot borrow mutably
```

In here, `x` isn't mutable, so when we try to mutably borrow it in `y`, it
fails. To fix this error, you need to make `x` mutable:

```
let mut x = 1;
let y = &mut x; // ok!
```
